I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team. The hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

I found it in #north-random. Ilse posted it there on Oct 13, along with a warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. Dana is a member of #north-random, and a ticket number is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share in #north-team.
